headline: Expedia Group (EXPE) Q2 Beat And Higher Guidance Leave Valuation In Focus
summary: Expedia Group (EXPE) is back in focus after reporting second quarter 2026 results that topped revenue and earnings estimates, raised full-year guidance, and paired the update with a dividend and ongoing buybacks. See our latest analysis for Expedia Group. Expedia Group’s latest results have come after a strong run, with a 90 day share price return of 33.3% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 64.69%.
